nodes.label: Release Workflow
nodes.rationale: Builds the Mac app on GitHub's machines, not a developer's Mac, so no personal certificate leaves a laptop and every image can be attested; a tag push makes a draft release, a manual run only an artifact.

nodes.label: Tag Matches MARKETING_VERSION Check
nodes.rationale: The tag must equal v<MARKETING_VERSION> from ios/Config/Base.xcconfig, so a release can never ship a disk image whose version disagrees with its tag.

nodes.label: Build Provenance Attestation Step
nodes.rationale: Runs only on a public repository, because GitHub does not store attestations for private repositories on free accounts; that is why 0.1.0 has only a SHA-256.

nodes.label: Changelog Section as Release Notes
nodes.rationale: awk extracts this version's CHANGELOG section and perl joins wrapped list-item lines; if no section exists it falls back to GitHub's generated notes.

nodes.label: Draft Release Creation
nodes.rationale: The release is created as a draft with the disk image and its SHA-256, so a human checks it before it becomes public.

nodes.label: SHA-Pinned GitHub Actions
nodes.rationale: Every action is pinned to a commit SHA with a version comment, and checkout uses persist-credentials: false, so a retagged action cannot silently change what the release build runs.
